name: shared-app-definition
$tagsComment: Tier 3 of docs/business-apps/architecture.md: the app definition's contract, which the engines render and the pipeline, the designer, the agent and the Studio migration all write. Shared code, not an engine: tier 3's engines render it. The first scope:engine project, libs/shared/computations, depends on it, and phase 1's record-page engine will. Plain TypeScript, so a Node command line and the browser can both use it.

test.$inputsComment: nx.json's test inputs, plus the documents the tests hold this library to: the layout version 2 proposal, whose examples must validate, the extension reference, whose rules and row actions the registries must match, and the administrator's guide, which must list every kit (kit-lists.spec.ts). Each kit's app.json and package.xml too, and the committed parity corpus, so that a new kit makes this project affected and kit-lists.spec.ts runs on it. Without them an edit to any would replay a cached pass, or run nothing.

typecheck.$comment: Plain TypeScript, so tsc rather than ngc. The spec files are type-checked by the spec-types gate through tsconfig.spec.json.
